Definition: from G2372; to put in a passion, i.e. enrage:--be wroth.
BiblicalUsage: In Scripture, thymóō is the word for to be made wroth, to be enraged. In Matthew 2:16, was exceeding wroth, and sent forth. In the Greek text the word is spelled θυμόομαι.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Herod’s wrath shows me what fear does to a king, and I will not let fear rule me.
